feature_scaling: L_t coordinate means and one global centered RMS; squared distance divided by feature dimension
optimizer: L-BFGS-B exact float64 marginal likelihood; maxls20 maxcor10 ftol1e-9 gtol1e-5
linear_optimizer_exception: reuse Phase0 three fixed starts; report separately as kernel sensitivity
projection_weight_initialization: N(0,1/input_dim), zero bias, ELU, no response-independent regularizer
fusion: train-only zscore+PCA64 each GNN/LLM block, train RMS block normalization, concatenate128; same 8256 projection parameters as GNN128->64
evaluation: 416 previously used validation rows per seed; development evidence only
primary_metric: paired mean across endpoints of RMSE divided by historical L0 endpoint std
candidate_rule: SHA256 representation_gp_v1:seed:ID sorting of each current U_t
llm: local pretrained Qwen1.5-0.5B-Chat exploratory frozen causal hidden state; T5 unavailable
llm_pooling: attention-masked last-hidden-state mean; no chat template; no generation
stopping: stop on safety/hash/numerical invalidity; preserve finite nonconverged fits and all completed methods; never prune by evaluation score
